name: 3/4 spell swap
source:
A student at a magical college wakes up under some sort of enchantment. The spell slash potion slash whatever it is has one known effect: it turns the victim into a woman!

Now, that student's working together with one of four schoolmates to carry out a mission:  to find the [s]kind helper[/s] perpetrator and [s]thank them profusely[/s] get to the truth of this mystery!

[From [url=https://cowboy-starshine.itch.io/3-4-spell-swap]itch.io[/url]]
